translation:
In the conditions of injury, constipation of the stool, if it is due to blood deficiency of the large intestine with blazing fire, use Four Substances Decoction (四物湯) to send down the Intestine-Moistening Pill (潤腸丸), or guide it with pig bile (豬膽汁). If it is due to kidney deficiency with dryness and fire, use Six-Ingredient Rehmannia Pill (六味地黃丸). If the qi of the intestines and stomach is deficient, use Supplementing the Middle and Benefiting Qi Decoction (補中益氣湯). If the stool is bound and constipated, with interior repletion and strong qi, and the abdomen is painful and hard, use Jade Candle Powder (玉燭散). <ins>Intestine-Moistening Pill (潤腸丸)</ins>
Rhubarb (大黃), dang gui tail (當歸尾), notopterygium (羌活, each five qian), peach kernel (桃仁), hemp seed (麻仁, each one liang)
Above, grind into powder, make into pills with refined honey the size of a pellet (彈子); on an empty stomach, send down with plain water.
